region.h: h>max(35,2(35-A)+abs(r)) with h congruent to r mod 2

theorem: No LR-anchored Leech bi-spider satisfies 1<=A<=50, -15<=r<=20 and h=N-2A>max(35,2(35-A)+abs(r)). Consequently no LR-anchored Leech bi-spider of order n>=18 exists when combined with the six earlier LR regions.
trust_boundary: Paired finite relaxed top-window exhaustion. Above the displayed threshold, every distance N-k with 0<=k<=35 has one of the forms p+b or r+b+b' on different right legs. Each implementation retains global uniqueness of these high offsets plus the necessary within-cluster collision classes, while omitting parameter-dependent cross-class collisions, all vertices outside the top window and the vertex budget. The omission only enlarges the search space.
